layers.authority: Balai Taman Nasional Wakatobi (national park office, Ministry of Forestry)
layers.process: Wakatobi National Park sells tickets online. Foreign visitors pay IDR 150,000 a person a day (about A$11.74, RBA rate of 30 October 2026, IDR 12,780 per A$1) and IDR 225,000 on holidays (about A$17.61). Activity tickets are extra: scuba diving IDR 25,000 a person a day (about A$1.96), snorkelling IDR 15,000 (about A$1.17) and fishing IDR 25,000 (about A$1.96). Boats pay too: a motor boat of 40 to 100 horsepower IDR 100,000 a day (about A$7.82) and a cruise yacht IDR 2,000,000 per unit a day (about A$156.49).

The park's site links a separate SIMAKSI (entry permit for specified activities) service, with ticket counters on Kaledupa, Tomia - Binongko and Wangi-Wangi. The permit rules themselves were not on the pages read.

laws.rule: Province-wide, everyone is forbidden to burn forest or land (Perda Provinsi Sulawesi Tenggara No. 7 of 2023 on forest and land fire control, art. 13(1)). The only exceptions are specific government fire-control, pest or habitat work, and local smallholders clearing at most 2 hectares of their own land per household for local food or seasonal crops under local wisdom, with written approval from the regional agriculture or plantation office, a firebreak around the plot, and no simultaneous burning across the same area (art. 13(2) and (3)). The perda's own sanctions are administrative (written warning, administrative fine, government coercion such as seizure of fire-causing equipment, and suspension or revocation of a business licence) for 'every person and/or permit holder' who breaches art. 13(1) and other listed articles (art. 44(1)); no administrative-fine amount is set in the perda.
